netra.citation: Netra (2026). Carbon claim dataset. IEEE ClimateChain Global Hackathon 2026. https://netra.rofihosted.space
netra.licence: Data derived from the Berkeley Carbon Trading Project VROD is shared under CC BY 4.0; keep the attribution to Berkeley and to Netra. Code: MIT.
sources: Berkeley Carbon Trading Project, Voluntary Registry Offsets Database v2026-08 (CC BY 4.0)
Probst et al. 2024, Nature Communications, doi:10.1038/s41467-024-53645-z
Company annual and sustainability reports (one URL per row)
netra.method: Likely real tonnes = tonnes x the share of real reductions measured for the project type in peer-reviewed research; only where three sources agree on the type. Grade A >= 60%, B 40-60%, C 20-40%, D 10-20%, E < 10% of researched tonnes. Averages per project type, not verdicts on any project.
